intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Solid support, designed to elevate your everyday
features.text: Built with engineered wood, our bed offers dependable durability wrapped in a look that’s quietly confident and effortlessly elegant.

features.title: Hydraulic storage that works behind the scenes
features.text: Lift, store, and simplify — the hydraulic storage base offers easy access to spacious compartments, keeping everything you need close but out of sight. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Lean back and relax, your way
features.text: The cushioned headboard delivers plush comfort and support — made for morning stretches, late-night scrolls, and everything in between.

features.title: Textured beauty, grounded in calm
features.text: The matte wood finish adds texture and warmth, giving your room a natural, lived-in feel without overwhelming your space.

features.title: Smart storage in your headboard, too
features.text: With built-in shelving and a clean ledge-style display, your bedtime favourites are always right where you need them — neat, accessible, and beautifully arranged.

name: Upmods Lattice King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
